title: platform-objects: hide invite_user ×4, create_user and set_user_password when features.cloudManaged is on (visible predicates, hide-when-on)
body:
Blocked-by: #25294

Engine half, item 2, of the coordinating card #25083 (`domain:services`, p1), filed on the hand-off from `domain:services` seat 1 (comment 6349658918 on this lane's seat post #20966). Binding text: ruling 6341690661 on #25083, **Q3 → A** (`features.cloudManaged`, hide-when-on gate semantics) and **Q4 → A** (the password doors split by population).
- **Who acts:** `domain:engine`.
- **Blocked by:** the `domain:spec` registry entry for `features.cloudManaged` and its hide-when-on semantics (handed off on the spec seat post #18549): the forward guard `packages/platform-objects/src/feature-gate-guard.test.ts` reads that registry.
- **Dedupe:** none found.

Part of #25083.

## Wanted
- `visible` predicates gated on `features.cloudManaged` with hide-when-on semantics (`features.cloudManaged != true`) on:
  - the four `invite_user` actions: `sys-user.object.ts`, `sys-member.object.ts`, `sys-invitation.object.ts`, `sys-organization.object.ts`;
  - `create_user`;
  - `set_user_password` — hidden in the console only; the server keeps answering it on an `env_native` row (Q4 → A: the break-glass admin stays editable), so ⛔ no server-side refusal here.
- The forward guard (`feature-gate-guard.test.ts`) accepts the new gate through the spec registry, not a local allow-list.

## Acceptance
- Pinned: with `features.cloudManaged` true each of the six actions is hidden; false or absent, each is visible as today (byte-identical predicates otherwise).
- `Clause-②` / `Metadata-protocol` declared per AGENTS.md.
